# Keep native folder creation alerts and notifications aligned with the result

Local CreateSubfolderInternal returns after CheckIfFolderExists failure because that helper already alerts. Store creation distinguishes invalid-name and folder-exists alerts, and only on success updates flags/notifies the folder. CreateSubfolder then emits the folder-notification service event used by the JavaScript inheritance callback. Preserve the native result/notification boundary instead of inferring success from dialog closure or a duplicate alert. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/local/src.
